propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES as frozenset({'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'}) with no runtime configuration option, preventing tenants with non-standard resolved-status names from correctly classifying issues.

DC reconciler already supports configurable resolved_statuses via ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses sourced from config schema; Cloud must achieve parity by reading jira.resolved_statuses from config.
An issue with a custom resolved-status name (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete') is misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED due to the hardcoded set.
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses: list[str] with default ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'] and coerce via _as_str_list with REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.
probe.py classify_probe_response must resolve the configured set at runtime with fallback to module default on unset, empty, or ConfigError, mirroring DC's settings.py guard.
